name: Vegan Cheese
siboNotes: Most vegan cheeses are well-tolerated on SIBO diet as they're typically made from low-FODMAP nuts or coconut oil. Check ingredients for high-FODMAP additives like inulin or chicory root.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully - avoid products with inulin, chicory root, or garlic powder
Cashew-based varieties are typically safest for sensitive individuals
Coconut oil-based options tend to be lower in FODMAPs than nut-based ones
Store properly refrigerated and use within expiration date for best digestibility
alternatives: Tahini mixed with lemon juice for creamy texture
nutritionalHighlights: Usually lower in saturated fat than dairy cheese
